format: html
params:
  mode:     "learn"
  stage:    "explore"
  wf_path:  "wf.rds"
  fit_path: "fit.rds"
---

<!--
# POSIT ASSISTANT CONTEXT
# This is Phase 7 (Report) of the RBayesflow Bayesian workflow.
# This document is READ-ONLY from the workflow objects.
# All content is sourced from wf_state and the saved brmsfit.
# Do NOT suggest re-running any fitting code. Claims are traceable
# to wf_state fields loaded from params$wf_path.
-->

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
source("R/source_all.R")
`%||%` <- function(a, b) if (!is.null(a)) a else b
wf  <- readRDS(params$wf_path)
fit <- readRDS(params$fit_path)
```

## Workflow Summary

```{r wf-summary}
summary(wf)
```

**Mode:** `r wf$mode` | **Stage:** `r wf$stage` |
**RBayesflow version:** `r wf$rbayesflow_version`

## Model Specification

```{r model-spec}
if (!is.null(wf$formula))
  cat("Formula:", deparse(wf$formula), "\n")
if (!is.null(wf$priors_text))
  cat("Priors:\n", wf$priors_text, "\n")
cat("Parameterization:", wf$parameterization %||% "non-hierarchical", "\n")
```

## MCMC Diagnostics

```{r diagnostics}
diag_status <- if (isTRUE(wf$diagnostics$passed)) {
  "**PASSED**"
} else if (isTRUE(wf$diagnostics$acknowledged)) {
  "**FAILED (acknowledged)**"
} else {
  "**FAILED (not reviewed)**"
}
```

Diagnostic status: `r diag_status`

```{r diag-table}
if (!is.na(wf$diagnostics$rhat_max)) {
  diag_df <- data.frame(
    Criterion  = c("Rhat_max", "ESS_bulk_min", "ESS_tail_min",
                   "Divergences", "BFMI_min"),
    Value      = c(
      round(wf$diagnostics$rhat_max, 4),
      round(wf$diagnostics$bulk_ess_min),
      round(wf$diagnostics$tail_ess_min),
      wf$diagnostics$n_divergences,
      round(min(wf$diagnostics$bfmi, na.rm = TRUE), 3)
    ),
    Threshold  = c("< 1.01", "> 400", "> 400", "= 0", "> 0.3"),
    Pass       = c(
      isTRUE(wf$diagnostics$rhat_max < 1.01),
      isTRUE(wf$diagnostics$bulk_ess_min > 400),
      isTRUE(wf$diagnostics$tail_ess_min > 400),
      isTRUE(wf$diagnostics$n_divergences == 0),
      isTRUE(all(wf$diagnostics$bfmi > 0.3, na.rm = TRUE))
    )
  )
  knitr::kable(diag_df, caption = "MCMC Diagnostic Summary")
}
```

## Coefficient Summary

```{r coefficients}
if (isTRUE(wf$diagnostics$passed) ||
    isTRUE(wf$diagnostics$acknowledged)) {
  print(summary(fit))
} else {
  cat("Coefficient summary withheld: diagnostics failed and not acknowledged.\n")
  cat("Call wf$diagnose() interactively to review and acknowledge failures.\n")
}
```

## Posterior Predictive Checks

```{r ppc}
if (isTRUE(wf$ppc_complete)) {
  pp_check(fit)
} else {
  cat("PPC not yet run. Complete Phase 5 before generating this report.\n")
}
```

## Model Comparison (LOO-CV)

```{r loo}
if (isTRUE(wf$loo_complete) && !is.null(wf$loo_table)) {
  knitr::kable(wf$loo_table,
               caption = "LOO-CV Estimates",
               digits = 2)
} else {
  cat("LOO not yet run. Complete Phase 6 before generating this report.\n")
}
```

## Audit Trail

```{r audit-trail}
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show full audit trail"
if (length(wf$audit_trail) > 0) {
  for (i in seq_along(wf$audit_trail)) {
    entry <- wf$audit_trail[[i]]
    cat(sprintf("[%d] Phase %s | %s | %s\n",
                i,
                entry$phase %||% "?",
                entry$action %||% "?",
                format(entry$timestamp %||% Sys.time())))
  }
} else {
  cat("No audit trail entries.\n")
}
```

## Exit Log

```{r exit-log}
if (identical(wf$stage, "exit") && !is.null(wf$exit_log)) {
  log <- wf$exit_log
  cat("Method chosen:", log$method, "\n")
  cat("Justification:", log$justification, "\n")
  cat("User confirmed:", log$user_confirmed, "\n")
  cat("Timestamp:", log$timestamp, "\n")
}
```
